caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, full-length dress with a high neckline and a fitted waist, rendered on a plain, light beige background. The dress is composed of a semi-transparent beige fabric adorned with a repeating small, dark decorative pattern throughout. The bodice has a V-shaped front with vertical lines accentuating the central closure, and the sleeves are slightly flared at the ends with ruffled edges. The skirt is wide and voluminous, extending outward to create a bell shape. At the bottom right of the image, there is a rectangular swatch displaying a geometric pattern in beige, brown, and black, likely intended as a detail of the fabric or trim, and the artist's name "E. MILLER" is written in small letters below the swatch. There is no visible figure wearing the dress; only the dress itself is shown, headless, armless, and without hands. The drawing is enclosed within a thin rectangular border.
title: Dress
